abstract: The aim of our study was to compare laparoscopy with laparotomy for the removal of ovarian dermoid cysts. Thirty-eight women with benign ovarian dermoid cyst were allocated for either laparoscopy (18 patients) or laparotomy (20 patients). The two groups were compared for operative and hospitalization times and postoperative course. Operating time was longer (93.6 +/- 23.8 min) and hospitalization time significantly shorter (22.4 +/- 6.6 h) in the laparoscopy group. No complications were reported in either group. We conclude that operative laparoscopy is a safe procedure for the removal of dermoid ovarian cysts and is as effective as laparotomy.
abstract_ja: 本研究の目的は、卵巣類皮嚢腫の摘出について腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術を比較することであった。良性卵巣類皮嚢腫の女性38例を、腹腔鏡手術群(18例)または開腹手術群(20例)に割り付けた。両群について、手術時間、入院期間、術後経過を比較した。手術時間は腹腔鏡手術群で長かった(93.6±23.8分)が、入院期間は腹腔鏡手術群で有意に短かった(22.4±6.6時間)。両群とも合併症は報告されなかった。卵巣類皮嚢腫の摘出において、手術用腹腔鏡は安全な方法であり、開腹手術と同等に有効であると結論する。
